SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8292
October 23, 1940. 4L

Opium smoking dens in Nantao - notification of the Shanghai District
Opium Suppression Bureau calling for registration of dens.

Following receipt of instructions from
the Nantao Police Bureau to close sometime ago,
most of the opium smoking dens complied with the
order. There are however, some 20 small opium
smoking dens still operating secretly in Nantao.

On October 20, 1940, the Shanghai District
Opium Suppression Bureau （上海地方戒煙局）,
1286 North Szechuen Road, which is a subordinate
organ of the Ministry of Interior of the Nanking
Government, posted copies of a notification in the
various parts of Nantao in the name of Yen Soo Yung
（顏肅雍）, Chief of the Bureau, calling upon
opium smoking den conductors to effect registration
with the Bureau.

According to the notification, those
desirous of opening and conducting opium smoking
dens must obtain application forms which forms
should contain all particulars as to name of
conductors, age, nativity, residential address,
title of den, amount of capital, address of den,
name of guarantor, and address of guarantor etc.
On return of the application form, the Bureau will
make investigations to verify the particulars given
in the application, after which a business permit
and a permit for purchasing opium, will be issued
to the applicant when he furnishes a deposit of $500.
This business permit will be valid for six months
from date of issue and the conductor will be required
to pay a monthly business tax of $25.00 in Hwa Shing notes.

（左侧批注及印章）
Sec G
（印：SHANGHAI POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 24 OCT. 1940）
Comms/
Information

编号 S. B. D. 8292
1940年10月23日。4L

南市鸦片烟馆——上海区禁烟局要求登记烟馆的通知。

继不久前接到南市警察局关闭烟馆的指令后，
大多数鸦片烟馆已遵从该命令。然而，仍有约20家小型鸦片
烟馆在南市秘密经营。

1940年10月20日，隶属于南京政府内政部的
上海区禁烟局（地址：四川北路1286号），以该局
局长顏肅雍的名义，在南市各处张贴通知副本，
要求鸦片烟馆经营者向该局办理登记。

根据通知，凡欲开设和经营鸦片烟馆者，
必须领取申请表，表中须填写经营者姓名、年龄、
籍贯、居住地址、烟馆名称、资本数额、烟馆地址、
担保人姓名及担保人地址等所有详情。
交回申请表后，该局将对申请中所填详情进行调查核实，
随后，申请人缴纳500元保证金后，将获发
营业执照和鸦片购买许可证。
该营业执照自签发之日起有效期为六个月，
经营者须每月缴纳华兴票25.00元的营业税。

（左侧批注及印章）
Sec G
（印：上海警务处处长办公室 1940年10月24日）
Comms/
供阅知
（印：模糊圆形印章，内有签名 HP）

- 2 -

The deposit money will be returned to the conductor
upon the den closing down according to the regulations
of the Bureau.

It is learned that thus far none of the
opium smoking den conductors have complied with the
above instructions. It is learned from a confidential
source that the Bureau does not intend issuing the
permits although all requirements in connection with
the application will be gone through unless a sum
of $2,000 is paid as a bribe for unofficial recognition.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

保证金将在烟馆按照该局规定关闭时退还给经营者。

据悉，截至目前，尚无鸦片烟馆经营者遵守上述
指令。据可靠消息来源获悉，除非支付2,000元作为
非官方认可的贿赂，否则该局虽会走完所有申请相关
程序，但无意颁发许可证。

Subject Opium Smoking Dens in Nantao - ordered to suspend functioning.

Made by D. I. Pan Lien Fih Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

At the end of September, 1940, the
Nantao Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government
ordered all newly established small opium smoking
dens within its jurisdiction which are under the
guise of "Club Room" to suspend functioning.
There are some 20 opium smoking dens and 4 opium
hongs still functioning in Nantao.
It is now learned that these opium
smoking dens are endeavouring to effect arrangements
for their reopening.

（批：6 5/10）

REPORT
Date march 19 ......... 1940

Subject.................... Opium Hong in Nantao.

Made by. D.I. Pan Lien Pih.    Forwarded by.... Supt. J. Mason.

An opium hong entitled "Lao Yoh Zung
(老煜盛)" commenced operations at no.1, Lane no.68,
Nyi Oen Li (義安里), Loo Shiang Yuen (露香園) Road,
Kyeu Mou Dien (九畝地), West Gate, on march 17.
Posters advertising the hong were posted openly in the
vicinity. This is the first opium hong to come into
existence in nantao. The proprietor is one named
Li Yah wei, (李亞梅) a native of Zauchow, aged 51.
